items.title: Joe Loyacano Interview, 1959-08-20
items.q: [INTERVIEWEE] Joseph Lycanum. >> [INTERVIEWER] ...That's your full name, Joseph Lycanum? [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah, they used to call me Hook.

ctx.x: Oh, good. And Paul? Paul Crawford. And you're Mrs. Lycanum. I see. That's your full name, Joseph Lycanum?
Yeah, they used to call me Hook. On account of the noise.
